title: See every school in your programme

steps.say: One table of every school you look after, with its students, teachers, classes and practice hours side by side. A whole programme reads at a glance instead of school by school.
The totals above the table are the programme as a whole. The search box and the sort control on the header row narrow it by name, hours or students.

Read the Status column for a school nobody is running yet — it is flagged as awaiting admin. Tapping any row opens that school's own dashboard, and **Export** gives you the same table as a spreadsheet file.
The list holds still until you refresh it, so a number will not change under you while you are reading it. If a refresh fails you are told plainly rather than shown stale figures as current.
steps.terminal: That's the programme in one table — totals above, schools below, nothing moving under you. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
